prd.title: Field Queue (Karim)
prd.overview: The Field Queue is Karim's landing page after login. It is the field-tech equivalent of the Operator Dashboard: priority-first / age-second sort, distance-from-current-location estimate, and one-tap Acknowledge + En route actions. 5s live update with 100ms crossfade on changed cells per foundation §8.2. This is the load-bearing surface for Goal 2.2 (status visible across personas).

scope.platform: Reconcile web/src/pages/FieldQueuePage.tsx (422 LOC); emit Acknowledged + EnRoute; poll /api/incidents every 5s

requirement.title: Mount route at /field for field_technician
requirement.description: Register route in App.tsx wrapped in RequireSession with role guard for field_technician.

requirement.title: Priority-first / age-second sort (same contract as OperatorDashboard)
requirement.description: Sort incidents P1 > P2 > P3 > P4, then ascending age. Same contract as WO-004 OperatorDashboard locked #1.

acceptance.criterion: P1 row above P2 row at same age
Older row first within same priority

requirement.title: Per-row composition (band + reporter + distance + age + missing-evidence)
requirement.description: Each row renders: BandPill (glyph + text), reporter-badge chip, distance estimate (km from current location), age, missing-evidence chips.

acceptance.criterion: All five row elements render in order
Band and reporter chips are independent DOM elements

requirement.title: One-tap Acknowledge emits Acknowledged event
requirement.description: Acknowledge button on each row emits POST /api/events with Acknowledged{actor: karim, incident_id}. Click opens detail page on return.

acceptance.criterion: Click emits Acknowledged with correct payload

requirement.title: One-tap En route with ETA picker
requirement.description: En route button on each row opens ETA picker (1/5/15/30/60 min). On confirm, emits POST /api/events with EnRoute{actor: karim, incident_id, eta_minutes}. Opens detail page on return.

acceptance.criterion: Click opens ETA picker with 5 options
Confirm emits EnRoute with selected minutes

requirement.title: Distance estimate from navigator.geolocation
requirement.description: Use navigator.geolocation.watchPosition() to track current location. Each row shows distance estimate in km. Graceful fallback (hide distance cell) if permission denied.

acceptance.criterion: Distance cell renders with km value
Permission denial hides distance cell (no broken state)

requirement.title: Filter chips (mine / available)
requirement.description: Render two filter chips: "My assignments" (default) and "Available". Click toggles active state. "My assignments" filters to incidents with assigned_to=karim_id; "Available" filters to unassigned.

requirement.title: 5s live update + 100ms crossfade (foundation §8.2)
requirement.description: Poll /api/incidents every 5s. Changed cells crossfade over 100ms. New rows mount instantly. Per foundation §8.2.

acceptance.criterion: New rows mount instantly (no fade-in delay)

requirement.title: Area Labels per foundation §13
requirement.description: Implement Area Labels per foundation §13: field-queue-page, …-header, …-main, …-filter-chips, …-chip-mine, …-chip-available, …-incident-list, …-row, …-band-pill, …-reporter-badge-chip, …-distance-estimate, …-button-acknowledge, …-button-en-route.

acceptance.criterion: All Area Labels present with matching id and aria-label

requirement.title: i18n keys (EN + BN; ETA picker labels)
requirement.description: Add i18n keys for page title, filter chips, row distance/ETA, button labels, ETA picker options, toast messages. EN + BN parity. ETA picker options: 1/5/15/30/60 min.

requirement.title: MSW: Acknowledge + EnRoute event handlers
requirement.description: Extend web/src/mocks/handlers.ts POST /api/events to accept Acknowledged + EnRoute event types. Persist via idb-keyval.

requirement.title: Reconciliation: confirm field-tech role gating + no Hindi
requirement.description: Verify field_technician role guard works; verify no Hindi strings; verify distance estimate graceful fallback.

prd.test-protocol:
[Added last — written when implementation is near complete]
Seed mixed priorities + ages; assert rendered order. Sort correct.
Click Acknowledge on row; intercept POST /api/events; assert Acknowledged event. Event fires correctly.
Click En route; assert ETA picker opens; select 15; confirm; assert EnRoute with eta_minutes=15. EnRoute flow works.
Mock geolocation; assert distance cell updates. Mock permission denied; assert cell hidden. Geolocation integration + fallback work.
